title: CI の Pico SDK 取得と依存の事前検証
cause: GitHub run 42474916744 stopped because the CI runner had no Pico SDK/lwIP etharp.c for the standard host tests.
introduction_cause: SDK-dependent host tests were added without adding SDK and submodule checkout to CI.
escape_cause: Local host tests used a pre-existing sibling SDK, masking the missing clean-runner dependency.
deliverables: Pinned official SDK checkout and explicit PICO_SDK_PATH in the existing push/PR workflow
Read-only SDK preflight and positive/negative unit tests
Local validation evidence and scoped commits on canonical main
dependencies: Pico SDK 2.3.1 commit 079c6f39023649b154152db30f1d781e884879bc and its recorded submodules
User push and GitHub workflow re-enablement before hosted verification
